license: CC-BY-4.0 for source dataset, as stated by authors
real_annotation: AI contextual annotations by ChatGPT/Codex assistant. No independent human gold-standard annotation.
synthetic_annotation: 192 original AI-authored examples plus 408 AI-authored template/substitution examples; all marked synthetic; all products from a template share a group.
selection: V1 retained 384 contextual AI annotations. V2 inspected 350 lexicon candidates and 760 other comments; retained 324 candidates and 692 other comments. Four of those other comments were positive despite regex nonmatches. Added seeds 20261120/20261121/20261122.
limitations: Positive real samples were mostly located using a limited profanity candidate lexicon.
Source platform moderation may suppress profanity in goods reviews.
No claim of representative profanity prevalence.
review_record: data/annotation_decisions_v2.csv records the 1016 additional contextual AI judgments.
prior_test_protection: previous_split_membership.csv pins previous test groups to test. New-test metrics exclude every previously available example.
